verdict.rationale: The evidence covers meeting capture ('bot or no bot', bot-free beta), unlimited recordings and transcriptions, and search across calls. Nothing documents a mobile app or recording in-person conversations. Bot-free capture is a different capture mode for online meetings and does not show mobile, in-person recording, so the applicable axis has no supporting evidence.

support.subject: As a founder, I can record and transcribe in-person conversations from a mobile app, and those notes land in the same searchable workspace
